component.name: FRITZ!Power Monitor
component.summary: FRITZ!Box power and temperature monitor for COSMIC

description.p: A native COSMIC panel applet for monitoring live power and temperature readings from compatible FRITZ!Box Smart Home devices. It communicates with the FRITZ!Box directly and does not execute or depend on fritz_solar.sh.

Show live power and temperature readings in the COSMIC panel, monitor multiple selected devices, review power and temperature history, receive configurable temperature alerts, and switch compatible devices directly from the popup.

screenshot.caption: FRITZ!Power Monitor applet on the COSMIC desktop panel

description.p: Improve panel readability with Celsius units, right-edge padding, and tighter icon-to-value spacing.
Improve weather presentation and diagnostics, including a consistently aligned weather image header and image attribution.
Restore the weather menu layout to its pre-PR #143 design.
Improve reproducible Flatpak packaging and install complete AppStream metadata for COSMIC app discovery.
